thread:
jamie: Hey — running the CLI quickstart on WSL2 and my first call never completes. I run `redwood init` and it prints "Opening browser to complete onboarding..." but nothing opens and the CLI just sits there waiting. any ideas?
sam: which OS exactly? WSL distro? did you try a headless flow?
jamie: Ubuntu 22.04 on WSL2. I tried pressing Enter, nothing. The output ends with: ```Waiting for browser auth... (PID 2389)``` then nothing. I also tried the curl from the README and it returns a 402: ```{"error":"payment_required","message":"workspace requires billing"}```
luis: ah, this sounds like the CLI is opening a browser by default and not gracefully falling back in headless shells. two quick things: 1) try `redwood login --no-open` (there's a headless token copy paste flow), 2) create the workspace in the console and attach a card (if the API 402 is accurate).
jamie: tried `--no-open` and it printed a URL to paste, but when I follow it I hit the paywall page and the CLI still errors on first curl with 402. I'm not sure if the CLI should've surfaced the 402 earlier.
devex-bot: FYI docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart/onboarding (shows headless and env var flows) :link:
sarah: thanks for the report @jamie. there's a known UX gap where the CLI headless flow doesn't clearly show the billing requirement and the SDK retry logic treats 402 as transient in some cases. we'll fix that so people see a clear error and an inline link to add billing.
jamie: any ETA? i need to demo a prototype tomorrow and this is blocking firstcall for my team.
mike: for a quick unblock you can bypass the headless browser by creating a workspace manually in console (console.redwood.ai) -> New Workspace -> attach a payment method (you can use test card) -> set env `REDWOOD_WORKSPACE_ID=ws_....` locally and re-run the quickstart. that should let the sample app complete the first API call.
jamie: ok doing that now...
jamie: update: created workspace, added card, set `REDWOOD_WORKSPACE_ID` and `REDWOOD_API_KEY`, re-ran the sample curl and got a 200 and a hello response. first successful call! :tada:
sarah: awesome. action items: 1) Luis to add `--headless`/`--no-open` clearer docs and make CLI surface 402 as non-retryable with a link to billing, 2) DevEx docs update for WSL notes, 3) short-term: add a better error message in CLI next patch. assigning.
luis: will take the CLI change and a small docs PR. thanks for reporting the exact logs @jamie — those helped.
jamie: thanks all, much appreciated. :pray:
